metadata.disclaimer: Illustrative science objectives based on modeled terrain and mapped geology. Waypoints are not verified field sampling sites or certified safe locations.

waypoints.name: Surface Reconnaissance
waypoints.scienceObjective: Document visible surface textures and identify candidate rock features for closer inspection.
waypoints.observationTask: Capture contextual imagery and record visible surface characteristics.

waypoints.name: Terrain Gradient Survey
waypoints.scienceObjective: Examine modeled terrain gradients and assess visible surface conditions.
waypoints.observationTask: Record DEM-derived slope and capture imagery for terrain interpretation.

waypoints.name: Geomorphology Observation
waypoints.scienceObjective: Observe landform characteristics along a comparatively steeper section of the simulated route.
waypoints.observationTask: Document visible terrain morphology and compare observations with modeled elevation and slope.
